item.title: Mardaani 3 Box Office Collections: Rani Mukerji starrer has a fair start, 3.75cr net in India and 7cr worldwide first day
item.description: Mardaani 3 had a fair opening day at the Indian box office, collecting Rs. 3.75 crore nett approx. That's on par with Rs. 3.75 crore opening day of Mardaani 2 in 2019. Additionally, the film has earned USD 275K (Rs. 2.50 crore) approx overseas on its first day. The worldwide first day will come around Rs. 7 crore.
